meaning:
συμπαθής, -ές
(σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: Job.29:25 A (אָבֵל), 4Ma.5:25 א, 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 15:4 * ;]
1. affected by like feelings, sympathetic: 1Pe.3:8.
2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
